title: DV Session State
description: Schema for output/dv_session_state.json — persisted state across all DV plugin commands. Tracks phases, per-table validation artifacts, generated files, and report status.

engine.description: SQL engine for validation query rendering

source_session_path.description: Path to the directory containing mapping_parsed.json and intent_identification.json. 'session/' when DE pipeline was used, 'session/dv/' when standalone Excel mode was used.

input_mode.description: How this DV session was initialized. de_pipeline = from existing DE pipeline artifacts in session/. standalone_excel = lightweight parse of mapping Excel with output in session/dv/.

source_excel_path.description: Path to the mapping Excel file used in standalone_excel mode. Null in de_pipeline mode.

domain_knowledge_path.description: Path to the domain knowledge markdown file provided via --domain-knowledge. Null if not provided.

target_environment.description: Target Databricks environment for catalog resolution. Set by /dv-generate --env when engine=databricks. Null for Athena engine.

databricks_catalog_resolution.description: Resolved Databricks catalog/schema values. Populated by /dv-generate Step 0.5 when engine=databricks. Null for Athena engine or before /dv-generate runs.

source_catalog.description: Resolved Unity Catalog name for source tables. Default per environment from databricks-tenancy skill Source Catalogs table (e.g., '077382350852_buk_data_products' for dev). May be overridden by the matched tenancy row's Source Catalog column if it differs from the default.

target_catalog.description: Resolved Unity Catalog name for target table (per-tenancy per-environment from tenancy registry Write/Target Catalog column, or user-provided)

target_schema.description: Target schema (= target_database from mapping_parsed.json, exact value, no transformation). Identical to how databricks-artefact-agent handles target.schema.

resolution_method.description: How target_catalog was resolved. de_session_state = from existing DE session state env_config/dbx_config. tenancy_registry = matched target_database in registry, extracted Write/Target Catalog. user_provided = user supplied via AskUserQuestion prompt.

tenancy_name.description: Matched Feature Team Name from tenancy registry. Null if resolved via domain knowledge or user input.

environment.description: The environment used for resolution (same as target_environment)

phases.description: Tracks progress through the 3-phase DV pipeline

dv_init.description: Phase 1: Initialize DV workspace, ingest mapping, build validation contracts

dv_generate.description: Phase 2: Generate validation plans and render engine-specific SQL

dv_report.description: Phase 3: Ingest user-provided results and generate the validation report

contract_path.description: Path to the generated dv_validation_contract JSON for this table

plan_path.description: Path to the generated dv_validation_plan JSON for this table

sql_directory.description: Directory containing rendered SQL files for this table's checks

check_count.description: Total number of validation checks generated for this table

not_evaluated_count.description: Number of checks marked NOT_EVALUATED (e.g., crypto columns, empty source tables)

quality_validation_result.description: Per-table quality validation result from dv-sql-quality-validator (Step 4b)

generated_files.description: List of all file paths generated during the DV session (contracts, plans, SQL files, reports)

report_path.description: Path to the final validation report. Null until dv_report phase completes.

dv_safety_validation_result.description: Result of the SQL safety validator run during dv_generate. Set to 'passed' when all SQL files pass safety checks, 'failed' after 2 self-heal retries are exhausted. Null until safety validation runs.

file.description: Path to the SQL file containing the violation

line.description: Line number where the violation was found

match.description: The matched text that triggered the violation

dv_safety_violations.description: Array of safety rule violations found during dv_generate. Null until safety validation runs. Empty array when all files pass.

dv_quality_validation_result.description: Result of the SQL quality validator run during dv_generate Step 4b. Set to 'passed' when all SQL files pass quality checks, 'passed_with_warnings' when only warning-level violations exist, 'failed' after 2 self-heal retries are exhausted on blocker violations. Null until quality validation runs.

file.description: Path to the SQL file containing the violation

check_id.description: Plan check_id affected by the violation, if applicable (e.g., for QUALITY-01 missing-check violations)

dv_quality_violations.description: Array of quality rule violations found during dv_generate Step 4b. Null until quality validation runs. Empty array when all files pass.

dv_quality_coverage_summary.description: Coverage metrics from the quality validator summarizing plan-to-SQL fidelity and rule evaluation results.

plan_checks_total.description: Total number of checks in the validation plan

plan_checks_rendered.description: Number of plan checks found in rendered SQL

plan_checks_missing.description: List of plan check_ids not found in rendered SQL

quality_rules_evaluated.description: Number of quality rules evaluated (some may be skipped by engine_scope or precondition)

quality_rules_passed.description: Number of quality rules that passed

quality_rules_warned.description: Number of quality rules that produced warning-level violations

quality_rules_failed.description: Number of quality rules that produced blocker-level violations

databricks_catalog_resolution.description: When engine is databricks, catalog resolution MUST be completed before /dv-generate can proceed past Step 0.5.
